content:
olivia-sre: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need to turn the postmortem actions into tracked tickets. Scope: auto-rollback rules, blast-radius hard caps, deterministic canary cohorts, and test coverage for rollback paths. Who volunteers for owners?

maria-eng: I can own the auto-rollback spec + runbook. Plan to include metric definitions, thresholds, and human override UX. Target: RFC by 2025-01-11.

liam-platform: I'll take blast-radius enforcement and the flag-create guardrail (reject > allowed unless whitelisted). Suggest defaults: prod default max 5%, stage 15%, dev no cap.

devex-sarah: I'll produce flag templates and CI linting rule: every feature flag factory must include rolloutPolicy and rollbackConfig. Will add language snippets and a GH action. ETA: 2025-01-08.

product-joe: I'll review any rollout % that touches billing or auth flows. Please tag me when you have proposed defaults.

infra-amy: Can we ensure the metrics pipeline tags canary cohorts with cohort_id so we can backfill and replay? I'll coordinate with telemetry.

olivia-sre: Yes, cohort tagging is required. Also need a console surface for "recent auto-rollbacks" and "rollouts exceeding cap". Liam, add a small API for emitting events we can surface.

deploy-bot: FYI: new staged deploy schema proposal:
```
deploy:
  cohort_percent: 5
  cohort_id: "canary-20250108-01"
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    rules:
      - metric: error_rate
        delta_pct: 0.5
        window_s: 180
      - metric: p95_latency
        increase_pct: 30
        window_s: 300
```

maria-eng: Proposed rollback triggers (first draft): sustained error_rate delta >= 0.4 pct for 3m OR p95 increase >= 30% for 5m OR spike in anomaly_score > 0.85 for 2 windows. Action: auto-pause then auto-rollback after 2min if no manual resume. Must log events and create an incident if rollback happens.

liam-platform: For enforcement: add config fields on flag metadata -> max_percent_prod, whitelist_teams, requires_approval. Block flag creation if > global_max unless requires_approval=true and approved_by present. Owner: liam-platform. ETA: 2025-01-20.

devex-sarah: For tests: I'll add a synthetic test that injects errors into a canary cohort and asserts the deploy-bot follows the rollback rules. Will run nightly in CI and on every change to deploy logic. Co-owner: maria-eng. ETA: 2025-01-15.

olivia-sre: Summarizing action items (will add to the tracking board):
- Auto-rollback RFC + runbook (owner: maria-eng, due: 2025-01-11)
- Blast-radius enforcement + flag-create guardrail (owner: liam-platform, due: 2025-01-20)
- Flag templates + CI lint + examples (owner: devex-sarah, due: 2025-01-08)
- Canary cohort tagging in telemetry (owner: infra-amy, due: 2025-01-09)
- Dashboard: active rollouts vs caps + recent auto-rollbacks (owner: olivia-sre + liam-platform, due: 2025-01-22)
- Synthetic rollback smoke test (owners: maria-eng & devex-sarah, due: 2025-01-15)

product-joe: I'll assemble a short policy doc for PM signoff on rollout percentages for product-impacting flags. Ping me for reviews.

liam-platform: One more ask: add a telemetry event when a flag is created/updated with the requesting user and approved_by to improve auditability. I'll include that in the change.

olivia-sre: OK, I'll schedule a 30m check-in next Thursday 9am PT to review RFC drafts and tickets. Please create the tickets and tag this thread. Thanks :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: NOTE: When rollback triggers, an incident marker will be created at /incidents and a slack alert to #eng-oncall will be emitted.

olivia-sre: Closing this thread; reopen if anything blocks your tickets.
